Results.ReviewText:
My trusty old Ducane of 8 glorious years finally met its maker a few months back.  Sadly, Weber decided to put this sub-brand out to pasture and acquiring a new one was impossible.  Price unfortunately was an issue, and so sticking with a 4 burner setup wasn't an option if I wanted to stay in the Weber family.  I was admittedly hesitant to step down to a smaller size grill, but since it's really not all that often I need the square footage anyway I decided to pull the trigger on the Spirit E-310.  

I opted for the original Spirit rather than the II for one huge reason: the enclosed storage space underneath.  To me, an open cart is obnoxious - I just don't want to stare at my propane tank & would prefer other items i want to store be out of sight.  So this in my opinion was worth paying more than the newer version.  The fact that it also has 4 casters vs the II which only has 2 and needs to be lifted to roll was another nicety I preferred.

Setup was a breeze thanks to the easy to follow instructions and nicely organized hardware bags Weber provides.  For any confusing steps, a quick YouTube search will land you some helpful video walkthroughs that clear up your questions in a snap.

So why 4 stars and not 5?  Two minor but palatable issues.  First, the warmup time is abysmal.  Granted it had 4 burners but my Ducane shot up to 600 degrees in under 5 minutes making a nice hot sear easy and automatic.  This puppy will get to the 500 or so mark no problem but the wait time is a tad longer.  As long as you're not in a rush to get done out there, you'll be ok.  Second complaint - hot spots.  Despite the claims from corporate, they are in fact a thing on this grill, and it's because of the burner layout.  Youll notice that the three burner tubes are connected on a T that runs additional flame on the back end of the grill.  So naturally, this increased heat source leads to uneven cooking status between what's in the back and what's up front - plan & layout your food accordingly.

These minor nuisances to once side I'm loving what this grill has to offer thus far and look forward to many more years of good use.

Results.ReviewText:
I am super happy with this grill. Meat and veggies have turned out very well.  I grilled chicken breasts on low and then indirect heat, and they were the completely cooked but incredibly juicy.  I am also impressed with the drip covers over the burners. They have a very steep angle compared to other grills, so drippings don't stick to them nearly so much. 
 HOWEVER... what stands out is the ease of cleaning.  I have had other grills, and charred gunk just builds up on the bottom.  It had to be cleaned once in a while, and it was a pain.  This Spirit E-310? I just wipe out the drip pan (fantastic idea!) and slide out the lower tray to clean it.  It is night and day from cleaning other grills.  
      To be honest I was a bit concerned about the size.  For a similar price I could have bought a bigger grill with maybe an added feature.  Glad I chose this one.  The three burners with the upper rack has been plenty, and if I need to it is no problem to grill the veggies first rather than at the same time. I'm not sure if the 2 burner size would have worked, but the three burner size has been fine.  For the same or maybe less I would have had a grill that would have lasted me a few years. Because of the quality of the design, the quality of construction, and the ease of cleaning I do not know if I will ever need to buy another grill. 
      Just so that you know this is a real review by a real person I'll toss in one thing I would like to change about the grill, and it is not the size.  My one issue has been the opening for the propane tank on the bottom of the grill.  It is a bit too big, so that then the tank is in place it sits on the ground rather than resting in the grill.  This makes it a bit hard to move, and I move it each time I grill.  I found this provides an anchor, making the grill less likely to be blown around in a strong wind.  If I put the tank on the bottom ledge with the door open the grill rolls easily, but you should keep this in mind if you buy it. 
    So... I would highly recommend this grill, and that is saying something.  I have been pleased with other grills, but never highly recommend them.  I am this one.

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
